source_excerpt: Standard plan €189/mo (100 search prompts, 150 for Agency Partners), Unlimited Workspaces, Google Looker Studio Connector, API/MCP access (2,000 requests/mo), 5,000 GEO URL Audits/mo.
observation: Otterly.ai offers a Standard plan for €189/month (or €160/month billed annually) featuring unlimited client workspaces, 150 tracked prompts for agency partners, Looker Studio integration, and base tracking across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Copilot. Additional engines such as Google AI Mode and Gemini cost €59/month each, and Claude costs €109/month.
interpretation: Direct pure-play GEO tracker already provides multi-client workspaces and Looker Studio exports for agencies, but extra AI engines require substantial modular monthly surcharges.

source_excerpt: Agency Partner Program: 150 search prompts on Standard (vs 100), 500 on Premium (vs 400), pitch workspaces, Looker Studio agency branded reporting, unified billing.
observation: Otterly.ai provides an Agency Partner Program for Standard and Premium subscribers that includes bonus search prompts (150 on Standard, 500 on Premium), dedicated pitch workspaces for prospective client audits, agency-branded reporting via Looker Studio, and consolidated single billing.
interpretation: Direct competitor actively targets marketing agencies with agency-specific pitch workflows and client workspace consolidation, directly overlapping with proposed agency features.

source_excerpt: Starter €85/mo (50 prompts, 3 models, 1 project). Pro €205/mo (150 prompts, 3 models, 2 projects). Advanced €425/mo (350 prompts, 3 models, 5 projects). Extra models €30-€140/mo.
observation: Peec AI brand pricing starts at €85/month for 50 prompts, 3 models, and 1 project; Pro costs €205/month for 150 prompts across 3 models and 2 projects; Advanced costs €425/month for 350 prompts and 5 projects. Additional models cost €30 to €140 per month.
interpretation: Brand-level pricing restricts project count tightly (2 projects at €205/mo, 5 projects at €425/mo), making standard brand plans economically ill-suited for multi-client agencies with 10+ clients.

source_excerpt: Essential €205/mo (1 client project, 10k credits, 3 pitch projects). Growth €425/mo (3 client projects, 25k credits, 5 pitch projects). Scale €675/mo (7 client projects, 65k credits, 7 pitch projects). 1 credit = 1 prompt x 1 model x 1 day.
observation: Peec AI offers dedicated Agency Plans using credit capacity (1 credit = 1 prompt x 1 model x 1 day). The Essential plan costs €205/month for 1 client project and 10,000 credits; Growth costs €425/month for 3 client projects; Scale costs €675/month for 7 client projects. All include temporary pitch projects, shareable dashboards, Looker Studio integration, and CSV exports.
interpretation: Peec AI restricts live client project slots in its agency plans (7 clients requires €675/month), creating high software overhead for small agencies serving 10+ SMB clients on lower monthly retainers.

source_excerpt: Starter $99/mo (1 engine ChatGPT only, 50 prompts, 1 seat, no exports, no API). Growth $399/mo (3 engines ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AIO, 100 prompts, 3 seats, CSV/JSON exports).
observation: Profound brand pricing offers a Starter tier at $99/month limited to 1 engine (ChatGPT only), 50 unique prompts, 1 seat, with no data export capabilities. Its Growth plan costs $399/month for 3 engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), 100 prompts, 3 seats, and CSV/JSON exports.
interpretation: Entry-level tier ($99/mo) completely blocks data exports and multi-engine tracking, while multi-engine tracking with basic CSV exports requires $399/month for only 100 prompts.

source_excerpt: Agency Growth: $99/mo base platform fee (5 seats, 10 pitch workspaces) + $399/mo per dedicated client workspace (100 prompts, 3 engines, CSV/JSON exports). Additional trial workspaces $199/mo.
observation: Profound prices its Agency Growth plan with a $99/month base platform fee covering 5 team seats and 10 pitch workspaces (7-day audit access), plus an additional $399/month for each dedicated client workspace containing 100 prompts across 3 engines.
interpretation: Profound's pricing model of $399/month per client workspace makes monitoring 5 to 10 clients cost $2,094 to $4,089/month, pricing out small independent agencies operating with SMB clients.

source_excerpt: Pro €99/mo (1,200 credits, up to 4,800 answers, 10 dashboard slots, 50 audits). Credit weight: 0.25 for standard engines (ChatGPT, Google AIO, Gemini, Perplexity), 1.0 for DeepSeek, 2.0 for Claude.
observation: Rankscale operates a credit consumption model where queries cost 0.25 credits on standard engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews/Mode, Gemini, Perplexity), 1.0 on DeepSeek, and 2.0 on Claude. The Pro plan costs €99/month (€84/mo billed yearly) for 1,200 credits (up to 4,800 answers), 10 brand dashboard slots, and 50 page audits.
interpretation: Rankscale delivers multi-brand tracking for up to 10 slots at €99/mo, but higher-reasoning models (Claude) consume credits at 8x the rate of standard engines.

source_excerpt: Growth €385/mo (5,500 credits, up to 22,000 answers, 50 dashboard slots, 200 audits). Full white-labeling, unlimited seats, Google Sheets sync, Looker Studio connector, REST API.
observation: Rankscale offers a Growth plan designed for agencies at €385/month (€327/mo billed yearly) with 50 brand dashboard slots, 5,500 credits (up to 22,000 answers), full white-labeling of shared client dashboards, unlimited agency seats, Google Sheets sync, Looker Studio connector, and REST API.
interpretation: A direct competitor already provides 50 multi-client brand slots, complete white-labeling, Google Sheets sync, and Looker Studio exports for under €400/month.

source_excerpt: Scale plan $500/mo ($416.67/mo yearly): 10 client brands included (~$50/client), 50 prompts/brand (500 total), all 8 engines included, unlimited seats, full white-label portal + client logins, REST API + MCP.
observation: Trakkr provides an agency Scale plan at $500/month ($416.67/month billed annually) that includes 10 client brand environments (50 prompts per brand, 500 total), all 8 major AI search engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AIO, Grok, DeepSeek, Meta AI) with no engine surcharges, full white-labeling on custom domains, dedicated client logins, Google Sheets sync, CSV exports, and REST API/MCP access.
interpretation: Direct tracker provides a turnkey agency solution with dedicated white-labeled client logins, Google Sheets sync, and all 8 engines bundled flat at $50/client/month for a 10-client agency.

source_excerpt: Starter (SEO + AI Search) $199/mo (5 websites, 50 prompts daily, 500 keywords). Pro+ $299/mo (15 websites, 100 prompts daily, 1,500 keywords). Advanced $549/mo (40 websites, 200 prompts daily, 5,000 keywords, API).
observation: Semrush combines traditional SEO with AI search monitoring across tiers: Starter ($199/mo, 5 websites, 50 daily AI prompts), Pro+ ($299/mo, 15 websites, 100 daily prompts), and Advanced ($549/mo, 40 websites, 200 daily prompts). AI visibility covers Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Plans include 1 user seat.
interpretation: Major incumbent SEO suite bundles AI search prompt monitoring directly into core SEO tiers, giving existing agency subscribers 50 to 100 daily prompts across 5 to 15 websites without requiring a separate pure-play tool.

source_excerpt: Pro Report add-on $20/mo: white-label agency reporting, AI-generated report summaries, interactive shareable links. Additional user seats starting at $45/mo.
observation: Semrush offers client reporting via a Pro Report add-on for $20/month, providing white-label custom branding, AI-generated summary text, automated scheduling, and interactive view links for external clients. Additional team member seats cost from $45/month.
interpretation: Agencies already on Semrush can produce white-labeled client reports with AI summaries for an incremental $20/month add-on, lowering the incentive to buy another stand-alone reporting tool.

source_excerpt: Core €109/mo (€87.20/mo yearly, 10 projects, 100 daily AI prompts, 5 GEO domains). Growth €235/mo (€188/mo yearly, 30 projects, 250 daily AI prompts, 15 GEO domains, 3 seats).
observation: SE Ranking includes native daily AI search prompt tracking in its base subscriptions: Core costs €109/month (€87.20/mo annual) for 10 projects and 100 daily AI prompts; Growth costs €235/month (€188/mo annual) for 30 projects, 3 seats, and 250 daily AI prompts across 15 GEO research domains.
interpretation: SMB-focused SEO platform bundles 100 to 250 daily AI prompts across 10 to 30 client projects at sub-€250/month pricing, directly targeting small agencies.

source_excerpt: Agency Pack add-on +€59/mo: +30 projects, 30 client seats, custom domain white-label (seo.agency.com), custom SMTP email reports, unlimited scheduled reports, Looker Studio integration. Dedicated AI Search add-on +€63.20/mo for 200 prompts.
observation: SE Ranking provides an Agency Pack add-on for +€59/month (billed annually) that expands project capacity by +30 projects, adds 30 individual client login seats, full white-labeling on a custom domain, custom SMTP email delivery, unlimited scheduled reports, and Looker Studio integration. A dedicated AI Search add-on is available for +€63.20/month for 200 prompts across Google AIO, AI Mode, Perplexity, and ChatGPT.
interpretation: An established suite allows small agencies to add complete white-label custom domain hosting, client seats, and scheduled reporting for €59/month on top of a bundled SEO/GEO base.

source_excerpt: Lite $129/mo (5 unverified projects, 5 daily prompts). Standard $249/mo (20 unverified projects, 10 daily prompts). Advanced $449/mo (50 projects, 20 daily prompts, Looker Studio). User seats $40-$80/mo.
observation: Ahrefs plans include limited daily AI prompt tracking natively (5 prompts/day on Lite at $129/mo; 10 prompts/day on Standard at $249/mo; 20 prompts/day on Advanced at $449/mo). Unverified client projects are capped at 5 on Lite, 20 on Standard, and 50 on Advanced. Looker Studio connector is restricted to Advanced ($449/mo) and Enterprise tiers. Additional user seats cost $40 to $80/month.
interpretation: Ahrefs provides very narrow native prompt tracking allowances (10 to 20 prompts/day) and restricts Looker Studio client connectors to high tiers ($449/mo), leaving room for specialized agency tools.

source_excerpt: Brand Radar custom prompt add-on packs: Basic $50/mo (+2,500 checks/mo), Growth $100/mo (+7,000 checks/mo), Scale $250/mo (+25,000 checks/mo). Standalone Brand Radar starts at $199/mo. Supported engines: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AIO, Copilot, Claude.
observation: Ahrefs offers standalone Brand Radar AI starting at $199/month, or as an add-on package ranging from $50/month (+2,500 checks) to $250/month (+25,000 checks). It monitors brand mentions across 5 platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, Claude) and accesses an index of 460M+ organic prompts.
interpretation: Ahrefs charges $50 to $250/month in extra add-ons to monitor meaningful prompt volumes on AI search engines, showing modular pricing by incumbents.

source_excerpt: Organic CTR drops to 8% when AI Overviews appear, but AI search visitors convert at 23x higher rates. Core agency tracking covers citation frequency, share of model voice, answer inclusion, sentiment, and crawlability across Semrush, SE Ranking, Profound, and Peec AI.
observation: Search Engine Land analysis by Casey Nifong reports that traditional organic click-through rates fall to 8% in the presence of AI Overviews, but AI search visitors convert at 23x the rate of standard organic search. Agencies evaluate four primary tools (Semrush AI Toolkit, SE Ranking AI Visibility Tracker, Profound, Peec AI) across citation frequency, share of model voice, and technical crawlability.
interpretation: Demonstrates that SEO agencies actively evaluate both legacy suite modules and pure-play trackers to report on high-intent AI search traffic, validating market activity around agency reporting.

source_excerpt: Agency Head of Solutions notes that while citation tracking is functional, prompt volume remains a black box with no public search volume APIs from LLMs, neural synthesis obscures why citations occur, and multi-source attribution cannot be reliably weighted.
observation: Practitioner analysis by Jason Tabeling (Head of Solutions at agency Further) identifies that while agencies can track citation presence, core visibility unknowns persist: LLMs provide no public prompt search volume APIs, neural text generation conceals the causal reason for specific citations, and multi-source synthesis prevents weighted attribution across blended sources.
interpretation: Confirms structural industry measurement limits; tools track citation occurrences and presence, but cannot provide exact search volume or causal attribution, leaving agencies with noisy data.

source_excerpt: Comparative analysis of Profound ($155M raised, enterprise read/write with agents), Peec AI ($29M raised, 1,300+ customers, mid-market B2B), Otterly ($29/mo entry, monitoring only), Rankscale (17+ models, AI readiness audits), and Rankshift (unlimited seats/projects for agencies).
observation: Industry benchmark comparing AI visibility platforms notes that Profound focuses on enterprise read/write with automated content agents, Peec AI has scaled to 1,300+ customers for mid-market monitoring, Otterly provides monitoring-only entry points, Rankscale tracks 17+ models with technical audits, and specialized agency trackers offer unlimited client workspaces and seats.
interpretation: Market is rapidly stratifying into enterprise execution platforms (Profound), mid-market monitoring (Peec AI), and multi-client agency-focused trackers (Rankscale, Trakkr, SE Ranking).
